question: What membership tiers does the store offer?
answer: Our store offers three membership tiers: Silver, Gold, and Black. Silver members who spend a cumulative total of 1,000 yuan can upgrade to Gold. Gold members enjoy a 10% discount, while Black members enjoy a 20% discount plus free shipping. Black membership requires annual spending of at least 20,000 yuan.

question: How long are membership tiers valid?
answer: Membership tiers are valid for 12 months. Upon expiry, the tier is reassessed based on cumulative spending over the past 12 months. Upgrades take effect on the 1st of the following month; there is no grace period for downgrades.

question: What is the refund policy?
answer: Unconditional returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery, provided the product remains in its original packaging and in resalable condition. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method within 3 business days after the returned item is received and passes inspection.

question: How long do refunds take to arrive?
answer: For refunds returned via the original payment method, bank card payments generally arrive within 1-3 business days, while third-party payment platform payments usually arrive immediately, subject to the processing time of the bank or platform.

question: Which items cannot use the 7-day unconditional return?
answer: The following items are not eligible for 7-day unconditional returns: customized products, intimate apparel, opened food and cosmetics, digital virtual goods, and newspapers or periodicals. Please read the product detail page carefully before ordering.

question: What is the return shipping address?
answer: Return address: After-Sales Department, 2nd Floor, Building 3, E-Commerce Industrial Park, Science and Technology Park, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province. Recipient: After-Sales Center, Tel: 400-888-6666. Please use a trackable courier service for returns; freight-collect packages will be refused.

question: What should I include when returning an item?
answer: When returning an item, please send back the product, any gifts, and the invoice together, and include a note with your order number inside the package. Returns missing accessories or gifts will affect the refund amount.

question: Can I return only part of a multi-item order?
answer: Orders containing multiple items support partial returns. The refund is calculated based on the actual amount paid for the returned items, and any coupons used will be returned or voided according to the rules.

question: What is the exchange policy?
answer: Within 15 days of delivery, products with quality defects can be exchanged free of charge, with shipping costs covered by our store. For exchanges not related to quality issues, round-trip shipping costs are borne by the buyer.

question: How does the exchange process work?
answer: Contact customer service to explain the situation and provide photo evidence. Once approved, an exchange order will be generated. After the buyer ships back the product and it passes warehouse inspection, the replacement will be dispatched within 3 business days.

question: How does repair service work?
answer: If a product malfunctions during the warranty period, you may contact customer service to request mail-in repair. After inspection confirms the damage is not man-made, the repair is free of charge. The repair cycle is generally 7-15 business days.

question: What are the shipping fee rules?
answer: Orders over 99 yuan qualify for free shipping to regular regions; orders below 99 yuan incur an 8-yuan shipping fee. For remote regions such as Xinjiang, Tibet, and Qinghai, free shipping applies to orders over 199 yuan.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Orders paid before 4:00 PM on business days are shipped the same day; orders paid after 4:00 PM are shipped the next day. Standard delivery takes 2-4 days, and 5-7 days for remote regions.

question: Which couriers do you use?
answer: Our partner couriers are ZTO, YTO, and Yunda. The system automatically assigns a courier based on the delivery address; specific couriers cannot be requested. Oversized items are uniformly shipped via Deppon Logistics.

question: How do I track my shipment?
answer: After shipment, you can view tracking information under My Orders in the official app. Tracking updates approximately every 4 hours; if there is no update for over 48 hours, please contact customer service.

question: Can I change the delivery address?
answer: Before an order ships, you can change the delivery address yourself in My Orders. For shipped orders, contact customer service to attempt interception; if interception fails, you will need to process a return after receipt.

question: What if the package is damaged on delivery?
answer: If the product is found damaged upon delivery, refuse the package and contact customer service. If damage is discovered after signing, please provide photo evidence within 24 hours; once verified, we will arrange a reshipment or refund.

question: How do I get an invoice?
answer: Electronic general invoices are available. Fill in the invoice title and tax ID in the order notes when placing your order. The invoice will be sent to your registered mobile number within 24 hours after shipment. Special VAT invoices are only available to corporate customers.

question: What are the coupon usage rules?
answer: Coupons cannot be stacked; only one coupon may be used per order. Threshold discount coupons can be combined with membership discounts, but sale items are excluded from coupon promotions. Expired coupons are voided automatically.

question: What is the newcomer gift pack?
answer: Newly registered users can claim a newcomer gift pack worth 88 yuan, containing one 20-yuan-off-over-100 coupon and one 50-yuan-off-over-200 coupon, valid for 30 days.

question: What are customer service hours?
answer: Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, including public holidays. Outside these hours you may leave a message, and our agents will reply in order after 9:00 AM the next day. Hotline: 400-888-6666.

question: How do membership points work?
answer: Every 1 yuan spent earns 1 point. Points can be redeemed for cash discounts on future purchases at a rate of 100 points = 1 yuan. Points are valid for 12 months from the date they are earned.

question: What birthday benefits do members get?
answer: Gold and Black members can claim a 50-yuan no-threshold coupon during their birthday month. Black members additionally receive a birthday gift box. These must be claimed within the birthday month.

question: What is the product warranty policy?
answer: Digital and home appliance products are covered by a 12-month nationwide warranty. Apparel, footwear, and bags are eligible for free repair or replacement within 30 days of delivery for quality issues such as loose stitching or sole separation.

question: Can activated digital devices be returned?
answer: Phones, tablets, and similar devices cannot be returned under the unconditional return policy once activated. Please confirm your needs before activating. Quality issues are handled according to the national Three Guarantees policy.

question: What is the custom product policy?
answer: Custom orders (engraving, custom sizes, etc.) can be canceled within 24 hours of ordering. Once production has begun, cancellation and returns are not supported. Customized products are also excluded from the 7-day unconditional return policy.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
answer: We accept bank cards, account balance, and major third-party payment platforms. Cash on delivery is not currently supported. Orders over 500 yuan are eligible for interest-free installments over 3, 6, or 12 months.

question: Will customer service ask for my password?
answer: Never disclose your account password or SMS verification codes to anyone. Our customer service will never ask for your password or ask you to transfer money to a personal account for any reason.

question: What is the privacy policy?
answer: Our store only collects information necessary to fulfill orders and never sells user data to third parties. You can review your information or delete your account under Settings - Privacy Management in the official app.

question: How does corporate procurement work?
answer: Corporate customers enjoy tiered discounts for bulk purchases: 5% off for 50+ items and 10% off for 200+ items. Corporate bank transfer and monthly billing are supported. Corporate procurement hotline: 400-888-7777, business days 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

question: How do gift cards work?
answer: Gift cards are available in denominations of 100, 300, and 500 yuan. They can be used storewide, are valid for 36 months, and are bearer instruments that cannot be reported lost or exchanged for cash.

question: What is the after-sales timeout policy?
answer: After a return request is approved, please ship the item and enter the tracking number within 7 days. Requests that time out will be closed automatically.

question: What if I refuse a package?
answer: Refusing a package without a valid reason will result in a refund minus round-trip shipping costs. For refusals due to product quality issues, shipping costs are covered by our store.

question: What is Member Day?
answer: The 18th of each month is Member Day. Gold members earn double points and Black members earn triple points on that day, with an exclusive member discount section available.

question: How does price protection work during major sales?
answer: For items purchased during the 618 and Double 11 shopping festivals, if the same item drops in price within 15 days of delivery, you may request one-click price protection to receive a refund of the difference.

question: What is the product authenticity guarantee?
answer: All products in our store are genuine and authorized by the brands, verifiable at brand counters or via official anti-counterfeit checks. Counterfeit products are compensated at ten times the price.

question: When is system maintenance?
answer: Scheduled system maintenance takes place every Thursday from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM. Ordering and order lookup may be unavailable during this window.

question: Who operates this store?
answer: This store is operated by Shenzhen Example E-Commerce Co., Ltd. The unified social credit code and business license information are displayed at the bottom of the store homepage.

question: How do customized product orders work with notes?
answer: For customizable products, place an order and include customization details in the order notes (for example engraving text, size, color, or gift message). Production starts after confirmation; see the custom product policy for cancellation rules.

question: How can I look up my order status?
answer: Search the store knowledge base or ask the assistant with your order number. Order records include product, customer name, status, and any customization notes attached to the order.
